messages:
Jess (sales): Hey team — BlueRidge legal asked for SIG CAIQ Q-by-Q. Can we assemble responses + artifacts? Need to deliver to their vendor portal by next Tues.
Alex M: I can own assembly. Do we have a checklist of which artifacts they usually want? SOC2, encryption diagrams, KMS policy, network isolation docs?
Maria (infosec): Yes — SOC2 Type II PDF, encryption-at-rest diagram, KMS key rotation policy, list of data flows, and contact for pen test report. Also they often ask for evidence that keys are customer-isolated (where applicable).
Tom E (eng): I can export the runtime config and an example kms rotation policy. Will redact any internal IPs. Which format do they prefer? ZIP or individual uploads?
Jess (sales): Portal accepts PDFs and zips. Pref: single zip with named files. Also they require file hashes for integrity checks.
Maria (infosec): Zip is fine. Please include a manifest.txt with SHA256s. For anything with secrets, provide a sanitized copy and note how to retrieve full logs under NDA.
Alex M: Copy. Tom, can you drop the KMS policy + minimal diagram to the secure share? I can add SOC2 and manifest.
Tom E (eng): Putting files here: https://redwood-secure-share/release/BR-1794/ (prelim link). Files:
```
kms_policy_v1.json (sanitized)
runtime_config_serve.yaml (redacted)
encryption_diagram_v2.png
```
Will add a short README for what was redacted.
Maria (infosec): Quick content note: For question CAIQ-ENCR-03 they ask about key rotation cadence. State: 90 days for data-plane keys; 365 days for root/management keys; automated rotation for data-plane where supported. Add references to our KMS audit logs retention (365 days) and HSM-backed keys in Private customers.
Jess (sales): Good. Also BlueRidge asked specifically about shared tenancy vs dedicated keys. We should include a short paragraph: when dedicated keys are offered (Dedicated + Private) vs hosted shared keys and the opt-in for BYOK.
Alex M: I'll draft that paragraph.
deploy-bot: New artifact uploaded by Tom E: kms_policy_v1.json (sanitized)
Tom E (eng): Also adding a small snippet customers ask for showing how they can call KMS rotate-key API from their infra. Putting sample curl.
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/kms/rotate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"key_id":"proj-key-123"}'
```
Maria (infosec): Suggest adding a note: rotation API requires audit log entry and operator MFA.
Alex M: Timeline: I'll compile everything into BR-SIG-resp.zip and upload by EOD Friday. Jess — can you confirm the contact at BlueRidge and whether they want files pushed to portal or sent via presigned link?
Jess (sales): Contact is emma@blueridge.com — she prefers upload to the portal but will accept presigned if we hit a size issue. I'll confirm and loop back.
Maria (infosec): If portal upload, ensure manifest + SHA256 included and that we send a signed email stating redactions.
Alex M: Noted. I'll also include a short cover email template and a list of redactions per-file.
Jess (sales): Awesome — thanks everyone. Ping me if you need SOC2 copy from vault access.
Tom E (eng): One more: I'm attaching a short network isolation snippet showing VPC peering and Private deployment flow.
Alex M: Perfect. I'll post final zip and message thread when done. :thumbsup:
